topic: The fastest ball ever bowled — and the batsman who hit it for six
hook: The fastest ball ever bowled — he hit it for six.
script: The fastest ball ever bowled — he hit it for six. Shoaib Akhtar clocked 161.3 km/h — the fastest ever recorded. Batsmen flinched. Some froze. Then Brian Lara stepped up and smashed him over the ropes. The fastest delivery in history. Hit for six. By the calmest man alive. Follow for cricket moments that prove courage beats everything.
